meta.name: choose-covariance-estimator
meta.description: Pick which precise covariance estimator to use for a given dataset. Use when you have data X and are unsure which estimator fits its dimension, conditioning, or tail behavior. Wraps precise.suggest() and covariance_features().

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为你的数据集选择最优协方差估计器
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为数据集选择协方差估计器但不确定哪个合适。
copy.tagline_en: Choose the best covariance estimator for your dataset.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to pick the right covariance estimator for your data.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会分析你提供的数据集，根据其维度、条件数和尾部分布等特征，推荐最合适的协方差估计方法，并给出推荐理由和特征摘要。
howto.when: 当你有一组数据，且不确定该用哪种协方差估计器时，Claude会自动分析并给出建议。

say.text: 帮我为这个数据集选择协方差估计器。
say.note: Claude会分析数据特征并推荐。

say.text: 分析这个数据的协方差特征。
say.note: 返回数据集的维度、条件数等特征。
列出得分最高的三种估计器。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes your dataset and recommends the best covariance estimator based on dimension, conditioning, and tail behavior, with feature summary.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide data X and are unsure which covariance estimator to use.

say_en.text: Help me choose a covariance estimator for this dataset.
Analyze the covariance features of this data.
say_en.note: Returns features like dimension, condition number, etc.
